description: Tests natural language fluidity - can the agent figure out which tools to use without being told explicitly? These prompts use domain vocabulary and loose instructions.

scenarios.name: Set up viscous liquid cherry-pick
scenarios.description: Loose prompt asking for viscous liquid handling. Agent should infer apply_liquid_preset(viscous).
scenarios.prompt: I need to set up a cherry-pick protocol for viscous DMSO-like liquid. Configure everything appropriately for this liquid type.

scenarios.name: Transfer from tubes to 384 plate
scenarios.description: User describes transfers in plain language. Agent should generate a CSV template.
scenarios.prompt: I have samples in a 96-tube rack in slot 4 and I want to cherry-pick 10 of them into a 384-well plate in slot 2. Each transfer is 50 uL. Set it up for me.

scenarios.name: Slow down for volatile solvents
scenarios.description: Domain-specific request about volatile solvents. Agent should reduce head speed and/or apply slippery preset.
scenarios.prompt: I'm working with chloroform which is very volatile and slippery. Reduce the head speed and configure the liquid handling to minimize dripping.

scenarios.name: Switch to individual well control
scenarios.description: User wants individual well control instead of full columns. Agent should switch to single_X1 or multi_X1.
scenarios.prompt: I realized I need individual well control, not whole columns. Change the pipette mode accordingly.

scenarios.name: New user basic setup
scenarios.description: Onboarding scenario - new user wants a basic experiment set up from scratch.
scenarios.prompt: I'm new to this system. Set up a basic cherry-pick experiment with standard liquid handling. I want to transfer from tubes to a 384 plate.

scenarios.name: Gentle settings for fragile cells
scenarios.description: Domain-specific request about fragile cells. Agent should configure gentle liquid handling.
scenarios.prompt: I'm working with fragile cells that can't tolerate aggressive pipetting. Configure the gentlest liquid handling possible.

scenarios.name: Fix splashing from previous run
scenarios.description: Troubleshooting scenario - user reports splashing. Agent should reduce speed settings.
scenarios.prompt: The last run had splashing issues because the robot moved too fast. Can you slow everything down?

scenarios.name: Implicit post-aspirate delay setting
scenarios.description: User asks for a specific setting change using natural language, not tool/path names.

scenarios.name: Multi-setting with natural language
scenarios.description: User requests multiple settings changes in one natural sentence. Tests compound NL understanding.
scenarios.prompt: Set tip reuse to never, add a 2.5 second post-aspirate delay, then validate my config with CSVs/example_basic.csv.

scenarios.name: DMSO implicit preset and generate
scenarios.description: User mentions DMSO and asks to generate protocol. Agent should apply viscous preset then generate.
scenarios.prompt: I'm working with DMSO today. Configure the liquid handling appropriately and generate a protocol from CSVs/example_basic.csv.

scenarios.name: End-to-end with no tool names
scenarios.description: Complete workflow using only domain language, no tool names at all.
scenarios.prompt: I want to handle DMSO samples going from 96-tube racks into 384-well plates. Configure everything for viscous liquid handling, make a transfer file with 6 transfers of 30 uL each, and compile the protocol.

scenarios.name: Cell suspension source mixing
scenarios.description: Domain-specific: user wants source mixing for cell suspensions. Tests mixing.location='source' mapping.
scenarios.prompt: Configure for cell suspension work. I need source mixing before aspiration to keep cells in suspension.
